boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along distinct Syracuse-area corridors, each paired with one verified reason to leave campus.

cards.title: Settle In With a Library Work Session
cards.subtitle: Springfield Road, across from Le Moyne College
cards.notes: Cross Springfield Road for individual study, library collections or a scheduled program; confirm holiday closings before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A public-library stop directly across from Le Moyne makes this the closest off-campus study option.
cards.evidence_claim: Soule Branch Library is at 101 Springfield Road, serves the Salt Springs neighborhood and offers public library collections and events.
cards.source_title: Soule Branch Library | Onondaga County Public Libraries
cards.access_notes: Current posted hours are Monday 9 a.m.–5 p.m., Tuesday–Wednesday 9 a.m.–7:30 p.m., and Thursday–Saturday 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Catch a Film or Live Performance
cards.subtitle: James Street in Eastwood
cards.notes: Check the venue calendar, choose an age-appropriate performance and verify its ticket and entry details before traveling to James Street.
cards.short_summary: The restored Eastwood venue gives the James Street corridor a concrete performing-arts destination.
cards.evidence_claim: The Palace Theatre at 2384 James Street hosts concerts, plays, musicals, movies and other audience events.
cards.access_notes: Access is event-dependent; consult the official calendar for the selected program's date, doors, age policy and ticket requirements.

cards.title: Choose a Court, Track or Walking Trail
cards.subtitle: Robinson Street on Syracuse’s east side
cards.notes: Enter from Robinson Street for the athletic complex, then choose the paved trail, track or courts that match current conditions.
cards.short_summary: One municipal park concentrates several active-recreation choices along the Robinson Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunnycrest Park at 698 Robinson Street has paved walking trails, athletic fields, basketball and tennis courts, a running track and other facilities.
cards.access_notes: City parks are posted as open daily from dawn to dusk; bathrooms may be limited to city programming or permitted events.

cards.title: Browse the Seed Library and Local Programs
cards.subtitle: Victoria Place, just off Westcott Street
cards.notes: Turn from Westcott Street onto Victoria Place to explore the collection, seed library, exchanges or a listed community program.
cards.short_summary: This neighborhood branch adds collections and hands-on community resources to a Westcott outing.
cards.evidence_claim: Petit Branch Library at 105 Victoria Place offers collections, a seasonal seed library, puzzle and magazine exchanges, art exhibits and public programs.
cards.source_title: Petit Branch Library | Onondaga County Public Libraries
cards.access_notes: Current posted hours are Monday and Thursday 9 a.m.–7:30 p.m., Tuesday–Wednesday and Friday–Saturday 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Walk to the Rose Garden and Lily Pond
cards.subtitle: Ostrom Avenue beside the university area
cards.notes: Start at the Ostrom Avenue address and pair the paved paths with the rose garden or lily pond; leave before the dusk closing.
cards.short_summary: Landscaped gardens and paved paths provide a specific outdoor reason to follow Ostrom Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Thornden Park at 201 Ostrom Avenue includes the E.M. Mills Rose Garden, a lily pond, paved walking trails and other recreation facilities.
cards.access_notes: City parks are posted as open daily from dawn to dusk; individual seasonal facilities may operate on separate schedules.

cards.title: Build an Afternoon Around American Art
cards.subtitle: Harrison Street at South State Street
cards.notes: Use the Harrison Street entrance for the galleries, and check current exhibitions plus student admission terms before departure.
cards.short_summary: The museum’s galleries make Harrison Street a defined visual-arts stop downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The Everson Museum of Art is located at 401 Harrison Street and operates public galleries, a museum shop and rotating exhibitions.
cards.access_notes: Posted gallery hours are Wednesday 11 a.m.–5 p.m., Thursday 11 a.m.–8 p.m., Friday 11 a.m.–5 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Monday–Tuesday.

cards.title: Step Inside the 1850 Weighlock Building
cards.subtitle: Erie Boulevard East in downtown Syracuse
cards.notes: Follow Erie Boulevard East to examine the historic weighlock building and its canal exhibits; allow time for nearby construction impacts.
cards.short_summary: The surviving weighlock building turns the Erie Boulevard corridor into a tangible canal-history lesson.
cards.evidence_claim: The Erie Canal Museum occupies the historic 1850 Syracuse Weighlock Building and presents exhibits about the Erie Canal.
cards.access_notes: The museum posts daily hours of 10 a.m.–4 p.m., with visitors allowed to remain until 5 p.m.; renovation work may affect the visit.

cards.title: Use a Full Evening Library Window
cards.subtitle: Jamesville Road in DeWitt
cards.notes: Head down Jamesville Road when you need an evening library session, and review summer weekend hours or holiday closings first.
cards.short_summary: Weeknight hours through 8 p.m. distinguish this Jamesville Road library stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Community Library of DeWitt & Jamesville is at 5110 Jamesville Road and posts Monday-through-Thursday hours ending at 8 p.m.
cards.source_title: Community Library of DeWitt & Jamesville - Visit
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–8 p.m. and Friday 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; summer weekend hours through August 31 are Saturday 10 a.m.–2 p.m. and Sunday closed.

cards.title: See Two Glacial Lakes and Old-Growth Forest
cards.subtitle: Green Lakes Road in Fayetteville
cards.notes: Continue along Green Lakes Road for lake and forest trails; review park alerts, permitted activities and any current vehicle fees first.
cards.short_summary: Two glacial lakes and surrounding forest provide a landscape-focused reason to extend the campus orbit eastward.
cards.evidence_claim: Green Lakes State Park at 7900 Green Lakes Road features two glacial lakes, old-growth forest and recreational trails.
cards.source_title: Green Lakes State Park - New York State Parks & Historic Sites
cards.access_notes: Review the official park page for current hours, alerts, swimming conditions and seasonal facility availability before traveling.

cards.title: Compare Food-Hall Counters in One Stop
cards.subtitle: South Salina Street in downtown Syracuse
cards.notes: Walk the market before ordering, compare posted menus and confirm each vendor’s availability rather than assuming every counter is open.
cards.short_summary: Multiple food merchants give the South Salina Street block a flexible group-meal destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Salt City Market is located at 484 South Salina Street and operates as a public market with multiple food merchants.
cards.access_notes: The market posts Monday–Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–9 p.m. and lists annual holiday closures; individual merchant schedules may differ.
